$schema: Community feed - maintained ONLY in the official repo. Edit this file, commit, and every forked site shows the same posts after auto-sync. Newest first. 'body' supports blank-line-separated paragraphs.

posts.title: Welcome to the Plickify community feed
posts.body:
This is where we share marketplace news, platform rule changes, selling tips and product announcements.

Check back regularly - or watch the bell icon in the header for tool releases.

posts.title: Tip: front-load your strongest keywords
posts.body:
Marketplace search engines weight the beginning of your title more heavily. Put the subject first and decorative words last.

Example: "Coffee beans pouring into grinder" beats "Beautiful amazing shot of coffee".
